system.effect:
Press
While your opponent is still recovering from your prior attack, you snag its armor, clothing, or flesh to move it as you please. Make a melee Strike with a spear or polearm. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, you can automatically Reposition it, with the same benefits as the Reposition action (including the Critical Success effect, if your Strike was a Critical Hit). Use your Total Reach for this Reposition.
This Strike has the following failure effect:
Failure The target becomes Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
